name: Healthy Hero
tagline: Run the 3D Power Worlds. Choose a lane. Learn a healthy habit.
description: A full 3D wellness adventure for kids: pick a hero, explore Wellness Island, and race through 30 missions where every Power Gate asks a food, water, movement, sleep, hygiene, or feelings question — with narration, Power Facts, Move Breaks, and Bubble Breathing.
title: Healthy Hero
